ruleDefinitions.name: Obfuscated IP Via CLI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of an encoded/obfuscated version of an IP address (hex, octal, etc.) via command line

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\ping\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\arp\\\.exe$")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ 0x.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/\\/0x.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.0x.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.00x.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*http\\:\\/\\/\\%.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%2e.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX("https?://[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}.0[0-9]{3,4}") OR process_command_line = RGX("https?://[0-9]{1,3}.0[0-9]{3,7}") OR process_command_line = RGX("https?://0[0-9]{3,11}") OR process_command_line = RGX("https?://(0[0-9]{1,11}.){3}0[0-9]{1,11}") OR process_command_line = RGX("https?://0[0-9]{1,11}") OR process_command_line = RGX(" [0-7]{7,13}"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX("https?://((25[0-5]|(2[0-4]|1\d|[1-9])?\d)(.|\b)){4}"))
